name: apex-global-systems
description: Monorepo del sitio web de Apex Global Systems — frontend Next.js y backend NestJS.

scripts.dev: pnpm run build:shared-types && pnpm --parallel --filter ./apps/* run dev
scripts.dev:web: pnpm run build:shared-types && pnpm --filter web run dev
scripts.dev:api: pnpm run build:shared-types && pnpm --filter api run dev
scripts.build: pnpm run build:shared-types && pnpm --filter ./apps/* run build
